meta.description: Hand-labelled gold set for the London / Tower Hamlets slice. Mirrors the Italian set but tests a corpus where the three English regimes (planning / building regs / HMO licensing) are legally separate — and where the student room-size rule lives at the HMO-LICENSING tier, not in planning.
meta.corpus: London Phase 1 — 6 documents, national -> regional (London Plan) -> municipal (Tower Hamlets)
meta.match_on: doc_key + article_ref against each retrieved chunk's metadata. article_ref '*' = doc-level (any chunk from that document counts), satisfied at most once. Doc-level is used for most London queries because oversized sections are sub-split into '(part N)' refs, which are not stable enough to label; the GPDO is labelled at article level because its 'Class MA' / 'Class L' refs are clean and stable.
caveats: Author-constructed, not validated by an English planning lawyer — state as a limitation. Every gold_value below was verified verbatim against the ingested text.
Doc-level matching makes this an easier task than the Italian article-level set; the two are NOT directly comparable. Report them separately.
The cascade filters on country=UK, so Italian chunks are out of scope here and the competition is among 212 UK chunks across 6 documents.

queries.query: What is the minimum floor area of a room used as sleeping accommodation by one person in a licensed HMO?
queries.gold_value: Not less than 6.51 square metres (one person aged over 10)
queries.note: THE English student room-size rule — lives in HOUSING/HMO licensing, not planning. Cross-country contrast: Italy=national habitability, Madrid=municipal PGOU, London=HMO licensing.

queries.query: What is the minimum sleeping room area for two persons sharing in an HMO?
queries.gold_value: Not less than 10.22 square metres (two persons aged over 10)

queries.query: Which permitted development right allows commercial premises to be converted to residential use?
queries.gold_value: Class MA — commercial, business and service uses to dwellinghouses

queries.query: Which permitted development class covers change of use between a dwellinghouse and a small house in multiple occupation?
queries.gold_value: Class L — small HMOs to dwellinghouses and vice versa (C3 <-> C4)

queries.query: What proportion of student accommodation must be affordable to follow the Fast Track Route?
queries.gold_value: At least 35 per cent affordable student accommodation (50 per cent where required by Part B of Policy H5) — London Plan Policy H15

queries.query: Must purpose-built student accommodation be secured through a nomination agreement with a higher education provider?
queries.gold_value: Yes — bedrooms secured through a nomination agreement with one or more higher education providers (Policy H15)

queries.query: What percentage of student rooms must be wheelchair accessible in Tower Hamlets?
queries.gold_value: 5% of student rooms wheelchair accessible, including a wheelchair-accessible shower room for independent use

queries.query: Has Tower Hamlets removed the Class MA permitted development right for converting commercial buildings?
queries.gold_value: Yes — an Article 4 Direction removes Class MA in the mapped area, so a full planning application is required
queries.note: JURISDICTION CASCADE demo: a municipal direction switches off a national permitted-development right. Contrast with uk03, which finds the national right.

queries.query: What is the definition of Class C4, a small house in multiple occupation?
queries.gold_value: Class C4 — occupation by between 3 and 6 residents as their only or main residence, sharing a basic amenity

queries.query: Which use class covers a dwellinghouse occupied by a single household?
queries.gold_value: Class C3 — dwellinghouses used as a single household (other than a use within Class C4)

queries.query: What are the planning requirements for purpose-built student accommodation in Tower Hamlets?
queries.gold_value: Policy on student housing: affordable student accommodation or nominations, respect residential amenity, 5% wheelchair-accessible rooms

queries.query: What is the maximum level of rent or affordability benchmark for student accommodation in London?
queries.gold_value: Policy H15 sets the maximum level of rent for affordable student accommodation
